response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), s AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - s.mean_rate AS diff_from_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN s WHERE r.rate > s.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: The track count includes every track matched to the media type, including tracks whose Bytes is NULL and so have no ratio.
Groups are formed by media type name. Media types with no tracks are dropped. The mean is the simple average of the per-type rates, and types with no computable rate are excluded from it.
Bytes is multiplied by 1.0 so the division is not integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Count only the tracks that contributed to the rate, meaning those with a non-NULL ratio.
